I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co. I can't see any account files for them, and nobody has mentioned Thornbury in #central-team.

One problem with the date: 23 May has already passed this year, since today is 14 Oct 2026. So they either meant May 2027 or it's an old date. It's best to check the date and year with your Thornbury contact or the account owner before anyone plans around it.

I replied to you in the #central-team thread. I also saved a note for this channel recording the date as unverified and the year as unclear, so it doesn't get treated as fact later.
